mainTopic: The end of the סריס/איילונית משנה, then a new משנה on a סריס חמה, an אנדרוגינוס and a טומטום, with ריש לקיש and רבי יוחנן arguing about תרומה, חזה ושוק and whether תרומה nowadays is rabbinic.
overview: The גמרא first asks whether the earlier משנה disproves רב המנונא, who says a שומרת יבם who was unfaithful is forbidden to her יבם. It answers that the משנה just kept talking about the יבם, but the same law applies with another man. Next it shows that the משנה's line about the איילונית cannot follow רבי יהודה, who holds that an איילונית is already a זונה. A new משנה then teaches that a סריס חמה כהן lets his wife eat תרומה, and according to רבי יוסי and רבי שמעון, so does an אנדרוגינוס כהן. It also rules about a טומטום found to be male, and about marriage and punishment involving an אנדרוגינוס. The גמרא explains that the ability to have children does not matter for תרומה. Then ריש לקיש and רבי יוחנן argue whether the אנדרוגינוס's wife may also eat חזה ושוק. ריש לקיש's view is explained as allowing only rabbinic תרומה nowadays. ריש לקיש brings a proof from a fig cake that is בטל, and רבי יוחנן rejects it by pointing to the exact wording 'את שדרכו לימנות'. The גמרא begins quoting that source, a משנה about clover bundles of כלאי הכרם, and the quote continues on the next amud.

steps.title: Does the earlier ruling disprove רב המנונא?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא suggests that the earlier משנה about a סריס יבם who had relations with his יבמה is a refutation of רב המנונא.
steps.simpleTranslation: Shall we say this is a refutation of רב המנונא, who said that a שומרת יבם who was unfaithful becomes forbidden to her יבם?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks whether the משנה we just learned disproves the view of רב המנונא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה said that when a סריס יבם has relations with his יבמה, she becomes disqualified from כהונה, and it only mentions the יבם himself. That seems to suggest relations with another man would not disqualify her. That fits badly with רב המנונא, who treats her unfaithfulness seriously enough to forbid her to the יבם.

keyTerms.meaning: Shall we say? It introduces a suggested proof or challenge.
A strong refutation
A widow waiting for her husband's brother to do יבום or חליצה
Disqualified or forbidden

phrases.english: Shall we say this is a refutation of Rav Hamnuna,
phrases.notes: "This" is the משנה's line that a סריס יבם who had relations with his יבמה disqualified her.

phrases.english: who said: a woman waiting for her yavam who was unfaithful
is disqualified from her yavam!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the discussion of the previous משנה from the earlier part of the daf.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב המנונא's ruling that a שומרת יבם who was unfaithful is forbidden to her יבם
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה only says she is disqualified when the יבם himself was with her. That seems to imply another man would not disqualify her, which is hard to fit with רב המנונא.

steps.title: Same law with another man; the משנה just kept its wording
steps.stepSummary: No refutation: she would be disqualified with another man too, but the משנה kept speaking about the יבם in both parts.
steps.simpleTranslation: No. The same is true even with another man. But since the תנא taught the first part about the יבם, he also taught the last part about him.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the משנה does not disprove רב המנונא at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה's silence about another man does not mean another man is allowed. The first part of the משנה was about the יבם, so the תנא kept the same case in the last part for style. רב המנונא's view stands.

keyTerms.meaning: The same law applies
Since, or because of the flow of the wording
The first clause
The last clause

steps.whatToRemember: A משנה may mention only one case for neat wording. That does not mean other cases are excluded.

phrases.aramaic: לֹא: הוּא הַדִּין אֲפִילּוּ לְאַחֵר נָמֵי,
phrases.english: No: the same law applies even with another man too,
and since he taught the first clause about him (the yavam),
he also taught the last clause about him.

steps.triggerLanguage: לֹא: הוּא הַדִּין אֲפִילּוּ לְאַחֵר נָמֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge in step 1.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Wording explanation: the case was chosen for style, not to exclude other cases.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The משנה's mention of only the יבם implies another man would not disqualify her.
steps.terutzMaskana: Another man disqualifies her too. The תנא just kept the same subject in both clauses.

steps.title: Reading the איילונית line closely: whose view is it?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה about an איילונית and infers that only relations disqualify her. Then it asks whose view this is.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: 'And similarly an איילונית with whom the brothers did חליצה...' The reason she is disqualified is that they had relations with her. If they did not, she is not disqualified. Whose view is this?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes another line of the משנה, draws a close inference from its wording, and asks which תנא it follows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה says that when the brothers have relations with an איילונית, she becomes disqualified. That implies that without relations she is fine. The גמרא wants to know which opinion this implication fits.

keyTerms.meaning: A woman who did not develop normally and cannot have children
They performed חליצה
The reason
According to whom?

phrases.aramaic: וְכֵן אַיְילוֹנִית שֶׁחָלְצוּ לָהּ אַחִין כּוּ׳.
phrases.english: And similarly, an ailonit with whom the brothers performed chalitza, etc.
phrases.notes: The rest of the line: the חליצה didn't disqualify her, but having relations with her did.

phrases.english: The reason is that they had relations with her.
But if they did not have relations with her, no.
According to whom?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves to a different line of the same משנה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which תנא holds that an איילונית is disqualified only through forbidden relations?

steps.title: Not like רבי יהודה, who calls an איילונית a זונה
steps.stepSummary: The line cannot follow רבי יהודה, because he holds an איילונית is a זונה no matter what.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is not like רבי יהודה. If it were, he says an איילונית is a זונה, so she would be disqualified even without relations.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that this line of the משנה does not follow רבי יהודה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה holds an איילונית is already considered a זונה and is forbidden to a כהן. According to him, the brothers' relations would change nothing. The משנה, which makes the relations the reason, must follow a different view.

keyTerms.meaning: Here: a woman disqualified from marrying a כהן
But didn't he say...?

steps.whatToRemember: The איילונית line in the משנה is not like רבי יהודה, since for him she is already a זונה.

phrases.english: Not according to Rabbi Yehuda,
for if it were Rabbi Yehuda, didn't he say:
an ailonit is a zonah.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 3.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The line is not like רבי יהודה, because for him an איילונית is disqualified as a זונה even without relations.

steps.title: New משנה: a סריס חמה or אנדרוגינוס כהן and תרומה
steps.stepSummary: A כהן who is a סריס חמה lets his wife, a בת ישראל, eat תרומה. רבי יוסי and רבי שמעון say the same about an אנדרוגינוס כהן.
steps.simpleTranslation: משנה: A כהן who is a סריס חמה and married a בת ישראל lets her eat תרומה. רבי יוסי and רבי שמעון say an אנדרוגינוס כהן who married a בת ישראל also lets her eat תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins. It teaches which unusual כהנים still let their wives eat תרומה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A סריס חמה was born this way, so his marriage is valid and his wife eats תרומה like any כהן's wife. רבי יוסי and רבי שמעון treat an אנדרוגינוס as a male who can marry, so his wife eats תרומה too.

keyTerms.meaning: Our משנה
A man who has been sexually impaired from birth (literally 'a eunuch of the sun')
The holy produce given to כהנים, eaten by them and their household
A person with both male and female organs
Lets her eat

phrases.english: MISHNA: A priest who is a eunuch from birth
who married an Israelite woman
enables her to eat teruma.
Rabbi Yosei and Rabbi Shimon say:
a priest who is a hermaphrodite and married an Israelite woman
enables her to eat teruma.

steps.triggerLanguage: מַתְנִי׳ סְרִיס חַמָּה כֹּהֵן שֶׁנָּשָׂא בַּת יִשְׂרָאֵל
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Start of a new משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A סריס חמה kohen lets his wife eat תרומה. According to רבי יוסי and רבי שמעון, so does an אנדרוגינוס kohen.

steps.title: רבי יהודה on a טומטום found male, and the אנדרוגינוס marrying
steps.stepSummary: A טומטום who was opened and found to be male does not do חליצה, since he is like a סריס. An אנדרוגינוס may marry a woman but may not be married to a man.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהודה says: A טומטום who was torn open and found to be a male does not do חליצה, because he is like a סריס. An אנדרוגינוס may take a wife, but may not be taken as a wife.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה continues with rulings about people whose gender status is unclear.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Even after a טומטום turns out to be male, he is treated like a סריס, so he does not do חליצה. The אנדרוגינוס is treated as a man for marriage: he can marry a woman, but a man cannot marry him.

keyTerms.meaning: A person whose organs are covered, so the gender is unknown
Who was torn open
Perform חליצה
Takes a wife
Is taken as a wife

steps.confusionAlert: Even though the טומטום was found to be male, he still does not do חליצה. Being male is not enough, because he is considered like a סריס.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehuda says:
a tumtum who was torn open and was found to be a male
must not perform chalitza, because he is like a eunuch.
A hermaphrodite may marry, but may not be married.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: טוּמְטוּם שֶׁנִּקְרַע וְנִמְצָא זָכָר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the same משנה with more cases.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A טומטום found to be male does not do חליצה because he is like a סריס. An אנדרוגינוס may marry a woman but not be married by a man.

steps.title: רבי אליעזר: stoning for relations with a hermaphrodite
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר rules that one who has relations with an אנדרוגינוס is liable to סקילה, as with a male.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אליעזר says: For an אנדרוגינוס, one is liable to סקילה, as for a male.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה ends with רבי אליעזר's ruling about punishment for relations with an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אליעזר treats the אנדרוגינוס as a male regarding the prohibition of relations between men. So a man who has relations with him receives סקילה, the same punishment as with a male.

keyTerms.meaning: Stoning, a בית דין death penalty
As with a male
One is liable because of him

steps.whatToRemember: In several rulings of this משנה, from different תנאים, the אנדרוגינוס is treated as a male. רבי יוסי and רבי שמעון say he lets his wife eat תרומה. The משנה says he may take a wife. רבי אליעזר says relations with him bring סקילה as with a male.

phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer says:
for a hermaphrodite, one is liable on his account
to stoning, as for a male.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: אַנְדְּרוֹגִינוֹס חַיָּיבִין עָלָיו סְקִילָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Final ruling of the משנה, adding a third area where the אנדרוגינוס is treated as male.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: One who has relations with an אנדרוגינוס is liable to סקילה as with a male.

steps.title: Why does the משנה need to say this?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the משנה bothers to teach that a כהן who is a סריס חמה lets his wife eat תרומה, since it seems obvious.
steps.simpleTranslation: GEMARA: Isn't this obvious?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens by asking why the משנה needs to tell us that a סריס חמה כהן lets his wife eat תרומה. This sets up the next step, which explains what we might have wrongly thought.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A סריס חמה is still a full כהן, and his marriage is valid. So it seems obvious that his wife should eat תרומה like any other כהן's wife. The גמרא wants to know what new thing the משנה is teaching.

keyTerms.meaning: It is obvious. This is the גמרא's way of asking why a teaching is needed at all.
A man who has been unable to father children since birth

phrases.english: GEMARA: It is obvious?
phrases.notes: He is asking about the משנה's first case from step 5, the כהן who is a סריס חמה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Goes back to the משנה's ruling about the סריס חמה and asks why it needs to be said.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's ruling that a סריס חמה כהן lets his wife eat תרומה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: He is a valid כהן with a valid marriage, so the ruling seems to teach nothing new.

steps.title: We might have linked eating תרומה to fathering children
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that we might have thought only a man who can father children gives his wife the right to eat תרומה. The משנה teaches that this is not so.
steps.simpleTranslation: You might have said: one who can father children lets his wife eat, and one who cannot father children does not let her eat. So the משנה teaches us otherwise.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the mistake the משנה is protecting us from. We might have thought that a כהן who cannot have children does not let his wife eat תרומה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: One could tie the wife's right to eat תרומה to the כהן's ability to have children. The משנה shows that this ability does not matter. What counts is that she is married to a כהן.

keyTerms.meaning: You might have said. This introduces a mistaken idea the teaching comes to rule out.
One who can father children
It teaches us (that the mistaken idea is wrong)

phrases.english: Lest you say:
one who fathers children enables [his wife] to eat,
one who does not father children does not enable her to eat,
it teaches us [that this is not so].

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the 'it is obvious' question.
steps.terutzResolutionType: מהו דתימא: points to a mistaken idea the משנה comes to rule out
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Only a כהן who can father children lets his wife eat תרומה.
steps.terutzMaskana: Being able to have children does not matter. A סריס חמה still lets his wife eat.

steps.title: ריש לקיש and רבי יוחנן disagree about the אנדרוגינוס
steps.stepSummary: On the משנה's ruling that an אנדרוגינוס כהן lets his wife eat, ריש לקיש says this is only תרומה, not חזה ושוק. רבי יוחנן says it includes חזה ושוק too.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה says that רבי יוסי and רבי שמעון rule the same for an אנדרוגינוס. ריש לקיש said: he lets her eat תרומה, but not breast and thigh. רבי יוחנן says: he lets her eat breast and thigh too.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the next part of the משנה, about the אנדרוגינוס. It then brings an argument between two אמוראים about how far his wife's right to eat goes.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both agree that the wife of an אנדרוגינוס כהן eats תרומה. They disagree about the חזה ושוק, the parts of a שלמים offering that go to the כהנים. ריש לקיש limits her, and רבי יוחנן lets her eat these too.

keyTerms.meaning: A person with both male and female features
The portion of produce given to a כהן, which only a כהן's household may eat
The breast and thigh of a שלמים offering, given to the כהנים

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמְרִים: אַנְדְּרוֹגִינוֹס.
phrases.english: Rabbi Yosei and Rabbi Shimon say: a hermaphrodite [also enables her to eat].
Reish Lakish said:
He enables her to eat terumah,
but he does not enable her to eat breast and thigh.
Rabbi Yochanan says:
He even enables her to eat breast and thigh.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the סריס חמה to the משנה's next case, the אנדרוגינוס.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: ריש לקיש: an אנדרוגינוס כהן lets his wife eat תרומה but not חזה ושוק. רבי יוחנן: he lets her eat חזה ושוק as well.

steps.title: תרומה is also from the Torah
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges ריש לקיש: if חזה ושוק is forbidden because it is Torah-level, תרומה is also Torah-level.
steps.simpleTranslation: And according to ריש לקיש, what is different about breast and thigh? That they are from the Torah? תרומה is also from the Torah!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks ריש לקיש's line between תרומה and חזה ושוק. It says the line does not make sense.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The only clear reason to forbid חזה ושוק is that it is דאורייתא. But regular תרומה is also דאורייתא. So why should one be allowed and the other forbidden?

keyTerms.meaning: What is the difference? This asks why two cases are treated differently.
From the Torah (a Torah-level law)

phrases.english: And according to Reish Lakish,
what is different about breast and thigh —
that they are by Torah law?
Terumah is also by Torah law!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges ריש לקיש's view from step 10.
steps.kashyaTarget: ריש לקיש's line between תרומה and חזה ושוק
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Both are Torah-level, so there is no reason to allow one and forbid the other.

steps.title: ריש לקיש means תרומה nowadays
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that ריש לקיש is talking about תרומה nowadays, which is only דרבנן.
steps.simpleTranslation: With what are we dealing here? With תרומה nowadays, which is only rabbinic.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא defends ריש לקיש. His ruling allowing תרומה refers only to the תרומה of today.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After the בית המקדש was destroyed, תרומה is only a rabbinic obligation. So the real line is between rabbinic תרומה, which she may eat, and Torah-level חזה ושוק, which she may not.

keyTerms.meaning: With what are we dealing here? This narrows a ruling to a specific case.
In the present time, after the בית המקדש
A rabbinic law

phrases.english: With what are we dealing here —
with terumah in the present time, which is rabbinic.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge by limiting the case.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Narrowing the case: the תרומה in question is the rabbinic תרומה of today
steps.terutzHavaAmina: ריש לקיש allows Torah-level תרומה, which makes his line make no sense.
steps.terutzMaskana: He allows only rabbinic תרומה, so the line between דרבנן and דאורייתא holds.

steps.title: Then he should have split תרומה itself
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks: if so, ריש לקיש should have drawn the line within תרומה, rabbinic versus Torah-level, instead of bringing up חזה ושוק.
steps.simpleTranslation: But when the בית המקדש is standing, what? She does not eat? Then instead of teaching 'he does not let her eat breast and thigh,' he should have made the split within תרומה itself: when is this said? With rabbinic תרומה, but with Torah-level תרומה, no!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the answer it just gave. If the point is rabbinic versus Torah-level, ריש לקיש picked a strange example.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the answer in step 12 is right, Torah-level תרומה from the time of the בית המקדש is also forbidden to her. The simplest way to say that would be to split תרומה into its two levels. Mentioning חזה ושוק instead looks unnecessary.

keyTerms.meaning: The Holy Temple
Let him make the split and teach it within the same case
In what case are these words said?

phrases.english: But at a time when the Temple is standing,
what — [he does] not [enable her]?
Instead of teaching "he does not enable her to eat breast and thigh,"
let him distinguish and teach within it itself:
phrases.notes: "It itself" means תרומה. He should split תרומה into two kinds.

phrases.english: In what case are these words said —
with rabbinic terumah,
but with Torah-law terumah — no!

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲבָל בִּזְמַן שֶׁבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ קַיָּים מַאי לֹא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the answer in step 12 based on how ריש לקיש worded his ruling.
steps.kashyaTarget: The answer that ריש לקיש's line is rabbinic תרומה versus Torah-level חזה ושוק
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If that were the line, he should have split תרומה into its two levels rather than bring in חזה ושוק.

steps.title: No תרומה at all while the בית המקדש stands
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא explains that ריש לקיש means: she eats rabbinic תרומה only nowadays. When there is חזה ושוק, meaning while the בית המקדש stands, she may not eat even rabbinic תרומה, so she won't come to eat Torah-level תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: That is what he is saying: when he lets her eat, he lets her eat תרומה nowadays, which is rabbinic. But in the time of breast and thigh, he does not let her eat, not even rabbinic תרומה, since she might come to eat Torah-level תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the wording challenge. It rereads ריש לקיש's words 'not breast and thigh' as naming a time period, not a food.
steps.deeperAnalysis: "חזה ושוק" is a way of saying 'the time when the בית המקדש stands.' In that time she may not eat even rabbinic תרומה, as a safeguard. That is why splitting תרומה into two levels would not have said the same thing.

keyTerms.meaning: This is indeed what he is saying. It rereads the speaker's words.
Perhaps he will come to (do something forbidden). This is a reason for a safeguard.

steps.whatToRemember: According to ריש לקיש, the wife of an אנדרוגינוס כהן eats only rabbinic תרומה, and only after the בית המקדש is gone. While it stands, she may not eat any תרומה, so she won't come to eat Torah-level תרומה. רבי יוחנן lets her eat even חזה ושוק.
steps.confusionAlert: In ריש לקיש's words, 'חזה ושוק' does not mean only the food. Here it means the time period when the בית המקדש stands and חזה ושוק is given out.

phrases.english: That is also what he is saying:
When he enables her to eat —
he enables her to eat terumah in the present time, which is rabbinic,
but he does not enable her to eat at the time of breast and thigh,
phrases.notes: "The time of breast and thigh" means when the בית המקדש stands and these portions are given.

phrases.english: even rabbinic terumah,
lest he come to feed her Torah-law terumah.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the wording challenge by rereading ריש לקיש's statement.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Rereading the words: 'חזה ושוק' means the period when the בית המקדש stands
steps.terutzHavaAmina: ריש לקיש meant the food חזה ושוק, so splitting תרומה would have been simpler.
steps.terutzMaskana: He meant the time period. While the בית המקדש stands, even rabbinic תרומה is forbidden to her as a safeguard.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן's view restated: she eats even חזה ושוק
steps.stepSummary: After the back-and-forth about ריש לקיש, the גמרא brings back רבי יוחנן's opposing view: the wife may eat even חזה ושוק.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבי יוחנן said: he even lets her eat חזה ושוק.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא repeats רבי יוחנן's opinion from the start of the argument. This sets up the conversation between רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש that comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: ריש לקיש limited the wife to תרומה. In Step 14 the גמרא explained his view: she may only eat rabbinic תרומה, and only nowadays. רבי יוחנן gives no such limit: even the Torah-level gift of חזה ושוק is allowed to her.

keyTerms.meaning: The breast and thigh of a שלמים offering, given to the כהן
He lets her eat (he gives her the right to eat)
Even

phrases.english: And Rabbi Yoḥanan said:
he even lets her eat the breast and thigh.
phrases.notes: "He" is the אנדרוגינוס כהן from the משנה, and "her" is his wife.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Goes back to the second side of the argument from Step 10, after the challenges to ריש לקיש were settled.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The wife of an אנדרוגינוס כהן may eat even חזה ושוק, not just תרומה.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן asks if ריש לקיש really holds תרומה today is only rabbinic
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן asks ריש לקיש whether he truly holds that תרומה nowadays is only דרבנן.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוחנן said to ריש לקיש: Do you really hold that תרומה nowadays is only דרבנן?
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוחנן asks ריש לקיש to confirm the idea that his whole position now depends on. This sets up ריש לקיש's answer and proof.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In Step 12, ריש לקיש's view was explained as talking about תרומה nowadays, which is only דרבנן. רבי יוחנן checks that ריש לקיש really holds this, because that idea is what keeps his position standing.

keyTerms.meaning: Do you hold? / Do you think?
תרומה in our times (after the Temple was destroyed)
A rabbinic law, not a Torah law

phrases.aramaic: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן לְרֵישׁ לָקִישׁ:
phrases.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan said to Reish Lakish:

phrases.aramaic: מִי סָבְרַתְּ תְּרוּמָה בַּזְּמַן הַזֶּה דְּרַבָּנַן?
phrases.english: Do you hold that terumah nowadays is rabbinic?

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן לְרֵישׁ לָקִישׁ: מִי סָבְרַתְּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Directly questions the idea that ריש לקיש's position was built on in Steps 12 and 14.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Whether ריש לקיש truly holds that תרומה nowadays is only rabbinic.

steps.title: ריש לקיש says yes and brings proof from the fig cake
steps.stepSummary: ריש לקיש answers yes. His proof is that he teaches that a fig cake of תרומה mixed into other fig cakes is בטל.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: Yes, because I teach that a fig cake mixed into other fig cakes is בטל.
steps.whatsHappening: ריש לקיש confirms that he holds תרומה nowadays is only דרבנן. He supports this with a teaching he learned about a fig cake.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A round cake of pressed figs is an important item. One might think an important item like this should never be בטל in a mixture. If ריש לקיש teaches that it is בטל, he reasons, that must be because the תרומה involved is only rabbinic.

keyTerms.meaning: Yes
A round cake of pressed dried figs
Is nullified (literally, "goes up"); it is בטל in the mixture
Because I teach (this is how I learn the teaching)

phrases.english: He said to him: Yes,
for I teach:
a fig cake among fig cakes is nullified.
phrases.notes: He means a fig cake of תרומה that got mixed in with regular fig cakes.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רבי יוחנן's question and adds a proof.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Yes. The proof is that an important fig cake of תרומה is בטל, which only makes sense if תרומה nowadays is rabbinic.
steps.raayaObject: That תרומה nowadays is only דרבנן.
steps.raayaSupportSource: ריש לקיש's teaching: עיגול בעיגולים עולה.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן rejects the proof: being nullified does not show it is rabbinic
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן answers that he teaches that even a piece of meat is בטל among other pieces. The rule that counted items are not בטל applies only to a specific group of items.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: Don't I teach that a piece among pieces is בטל? Do you think we learned "anything that is usually counted"? We learned "that which is usually counted."
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוחנן knocks down ריש לקיש's proof. Things that are not on the special "counted" list can be בטל even when the איסור is from the Torah.
steps.deeperAnalysis: ריש לקיש assumed an important item like a fig cake could only be בטל if the איסור were rabbinic. רבי יוחנן points out that the rule "counted items are not בטל" was taught about "את שדרכו לימנות", a specific group, and not "כל שדרכו לימנות", anything that is counted. A fig cake is not in that group, so it is בטל even if תרומה were from the Torah, and the proof falls away.

keyTerms.meaning: But isn't it so that…
A piece (of forbidden meat) mixed among other pieces
Something that is usually counted (sold by the piece), which is too important to be בטל
Any / all, a broad wording
"That which", pointing to a limited, specific group

steps.confusionAlert: Do not think רבי יוחנן says counted items can be בטל. He agrees some counted items are never בטל. He only says the group is limited, and a fig cake is not part of it.

phrases.english: He said to him,
But don't I teach:
a piece among pieces is nullified.
phrases.notes: He means a forbidden piece of meat, which is a Torah-level איסור, and still it is בטל.

phrases.english: Do you think we learned "anything that is usually counted"?
We learned "that which is usually counted."
phrases.notes: The small word אֶת limits the rule to certain items, so not everything that gets counted is included.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof ריש לקיש brought in Step 17.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the proof only. It does not settle whether תרומה nowadays is rabbinic or from the Torah.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof assumed every counted, important item is never בטל. In fact the rule covers only a specific group, so a fig cake being בטל proves nothing about the level of תרומה.

steps.title: Where is the "usually counted" rule taught?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what source רבי יוחנן was pointing to with "את שדרכו לימנות".
steps.simpleTranslation: What is it?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks where the rule רבי יוחנן just quoted comes from. This sets up the משנה it is about to cite.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יוחנן's whole answer depends on the exact words "את שדרכו לימנות". The גמרא wants to see the original source so we can check that wording.

keyTerms.meaning: What is it? (which teaching is meant)

phrases.english: What is it?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source of the wording רבי יוחנן relied on.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The source of the teaching "את שדרכו לימנות".

steps.title: The source: the משנה about clover bundles from a vineyard
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא starts quoting the משנה: bundles of clover that are כלאי הכרם must be burned, and then it begins the case where they got mixed with other bundles.
steps.simpleTranslation: As we learned in a משנה: If someone had bundles of clover that were כלאי הכרם, they must be burned. If they got mixed with other bundles…
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins quoting the משנה that holds the "את שדרכו לימנות" rule. The quote continues past this point, into the case of the mixed-up bundles.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Clover that grew in a vineyard is כלאי הכרם, which is forbidden to benefit from, so it must be burned. Next the משנה turns to what happens when such bundles get mixed with permitted ones. That is where the rule about counted items will show up.

keyTerms.meaning: Bundles of clover (fenugreek)
Crops grown in a vineyard, which are forbidden to benefit from
They must be burned
They became mixed in

phrases.english: As we learned:
phrases.notes: This is a משנה in ערלה, chapter 3.

phrases.english: One who had bundles of clover
of forbidden vineyard mixtures,
they must be burned.
If they became mixed with others,

steps.triggerLanguage: דִּתְנַן: מִי שֶׁהָיוּ לוֹ חֲבִילֵי תִלְתָּן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of Step 19 by starting to quote the source משנה.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The rule is found in the משנה about bundles of clover of כלאי הכרם that got mixed with permitted bundles. The quote continues beyond this point.
